description: Menus you can drop on a page. One owned table of items grouped by menu name, a declarative admin screen, a public JSON feed of visible items, and a block the page builder's palette draws as a real <ul> of links — ordered by position, hiding rows with visible = 0.

fields.name: menu
fields.label: Which menu
fields.help: A name you choose. A block shows one menu, so `main` on /pricing and `footer` on /contact are two different menus.

fields.name: href
fields.label: Goes to
fields.help: A path on this site (/about) or a full https:// address. Anything else renders as plain text, not a link.

fields.name: position
fields.label: Order
fields.help: Lowest first. Rows with the same number fall back to the order they were added.

fields.name: visible
fields.label: Shown
fields.help: 0 keeps the row but hides it — a menu block never reads a hidden row.
